alpha_tasks.details: Fix three failed core checks: restore canonical identification/provenance hook wiring and establish a neutral generation baseline against the complete current source. Re-run full checks; do not replace expected results with the failing candidate’s output.

Wire Player Damage for direct attacks, spells, abilities, player-owned summons and attributable explosions. Scale once and preserve the original source, defenses, immunities and neutral RNG. Includes source-level regressions.

Wire Enemy/Boss Damage for direct and ranged attacks and boss-owned summons/delayed attacks. Boss replaces Enemy, never multiplies both. Preserve existing difficulty/challenge behavior and boss progression. Builds on A2 rather than counting shared architecture twice.

Preserve attribution for poison, burning, corrosion, other damage-over-time and overlapping explosions/blob cells through save/load. Prevent double scaling of shared or derived damage. Leave unowned traps, environment, starvation and Chalice self-damage unchanged. Highest implementation uncertainty.

Record all 18 values, 1–60 selected upgrade count and equivalent percentage, actual generated counts, difficulty/balance revision, nine challenges, class, seed and exact ruleset identity. Preserve historical unknowns and raw history; finish additive save compatibility.

Expose the exact run configuration and scoring status in run details, filters, comparisons, statistics and exports. Verify custom and standard runs remain distinguishable. This is mandatory integration; the wider UIMSD redesign stays deferred.

Show Custom Rules Multiplier directly below Challenge Multiplier; neutral is 1.00×. Preserve original earned scores while calibration is unapproved; show non-neutral multiplier/adjusted score as unavailable or provisional, never as an awarded competitive bonus. Store formula/version/status fields when available.

Verify unchanged active-run settings across preference changes, restart, load, restoration and rollback. Test legacy saves, invalid/incomplete metadata, healing fractions, new generation counts and owner attribution. No uninstall, clear-data or raw-history deletion.

alpha_tasks.task: Combined gameplay, classes, challenges and bosses
alpha_tasks.details: Exercise the approved hard/easy combinations, all six classes, Difficulty 1–5 and the nine challenges. Verify Goo, Tengu, DM-300, Dwarf King and Yog phases/objectives. Check spawn XP/drop interactions, extreme defense/HP/healing and low upgrades. Report interactions; do not automatically nerf them.

Touch and save every implemented control; inspect active-run rules and score breakdown. Verify small screens, scrolling, warning text, save/resume and HUD compatibility. Capture/review screenshots. Finish equipment interaction checks and perform applicable instrumentation; emulator evidence is distinct from phone acceptance.

alpha_tasks.task: Private alpha candidate and delivery gate
alpha_tasks.details: Run required core/Android/build checks on the final source; include accurate build history. Verify APK checksum, signing compatibility, application ID and install-over version against the last delivered APK. Stage APK and report privately. Owner approval precedes distribution to about 10 testers.

backlog.details: Continue the documented component checkpoint; do not restart reviewed components. Resolve confirmed history/cache/query/save defects in tested batches. Exact remaining component inventory must be reconciled before claiming the audit complete. This can become an alpha blocker if a crash or data-loss defect is reproduced.

Finish the screen/functionality checklist, compact native presentation, navigation state, tables, filters, reports and guide access without removing capabilities. Wider redesign is paused until critical slider work is finished.

Re-audit exact APK/source/release differences for every build through the current build, retaining all verified details and marking only genuinely unverifiable history. Missing artifacts cannot be reconstructed on a guaranteed clock; do not invent entries.
Verify native cards, popups, credits/licensing, navigation and high-entry-count history. Reuse working implementation; do not redo completed screens. Address confirmed defects only.

Verify discoverable controls, detected-hazard stops, damage/enemy/manual interruption, no automatic floor transition, zoom/fog/targeting and saved preferences. Features already have source/tests; this is remaining acceptance, not a fresh implementation.

Compare actual turn/attack/rotation scheduling with upstream and reproduce the avoidance failure. No arbitrary animation halving. A confirmed gameplay-timing defect is promoted ahead of noncritical polish.

backlog.estimate: 2–4 active hours once run evidence is available
backlog.details: Preserve the completed 100,000-seed finding of no global generation regression. Investigate shops, access, exploration, difficulty and the actual seed/save. Exact playthrough reproduction remains blocked if seed/save/route evidence is unavailable.

backlog.estimate: 1–3 active hours once affected state is available
backlog.details: Confirm Lost Inventory/backpack recovery versus capacity/bag handling from the actual affected state. Do not assume full inventory or alter capacity. Reproduce any unresolved defect, protect items/save and add a targeted regression.

Compare triggering/loading/scheduling and attempt measured reproduction. RedMagic/Android16 speakers: Prison and Tengu are confirmed observations, not boundaries. APD inheritance is unconfirmed. A reliable acoustic fix cannot be promised without reproduction.

backlog.estimate: 1–3 active hours for offline acceptance; online work not estimable yet
backlog.details: Preserve existing offline previews and navigation. Unfinished online voting/submissions/reviews/mod delivery must not be activated. Provider/scope/authorization decisions are needed before an online implementation estimate.

backlog.estimate: 2–4 active hours for supplied-report review; calibration time unknown
backlog.details: Review the actual Phase 3/4 scoring reports, incorporating other phases when supplied. The objective log-probability candidate is research, not a calibrated production reward. No new coefficients, duplicated extensive research or awarded multipliers without creator approval.

Triage crashes, save loss and blocked progression first. Every confirmed correction gets targeted regression and applicable Android/build verification. Do not invent a bug count or claim this open-ended work is complete.
